page_title: ALM 0-2 RAY | Almeria v Rayo Vallecano 11/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Sergio Akieme (Almeria) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
87' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for an infringement.
86' Here's the change. Oscar Valentin leaves the pitch and Diego Mendez (Rayo Vallecano) comes on as a substitute.
86' Substitution. Alvaro Garcia leaves the pitch and is replaced by Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano).
85' Luis Suarez (Almeria) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
83' Vicente Moreno prepares a substitution. Largie Ramazani is replaced by Marko Milovanovic (Almeria).
83' The linesman points to the corner flag, Rayo Vallecano are going to take it.
82' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Randy Nteka.
80' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Dion Lopy (Almeria) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
78' Vicente Moreno has decided to make a change. Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) replaces Iddrisu Baba Mohammed.
78' That will be all from Lucas Robertone who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Dion Lopy (Almeria).
76' A cooling break is underway.
74' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
72' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
70' The attendance for today's match is 14837.
69' One of the Almeria players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
68' Almeria have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
66' Vicente Moreno has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marc Pubill (Almeria) replacing Alejandro Pozo.
65' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
65' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Alberola Rojas had an easy-decision to make.
62' Substitution. Salvi Sanchez (Rayo Vallecano) has come on for Oscar Trejo.
62' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Sergio Arribas (Almeria), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
61' Almeria failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
60' Almeria work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
58' Stole Dimitrievski blocks Largie Ramazani (Almeria)'s effort from the edge of the box.
54' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
53' Srdjan Babic (Almeria) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
53' The referee blows his whistle, Almeria are awarded a corner kick.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Almeria comes to nothing.
51' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Javier Alberola Rojas didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
51' Dangerous play by Lucas Robertone (Almeria). Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul.
50' 58:42 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Lazaro is replaced by Sergio Arribas (Almeria).
46' Francisco Rodriguez has made a change at the break. Pathe Ciss has come on in place of Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.

45+6' A neat pass is well received by Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
45+4' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
45+2' Javier Alberola Rojas couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) and blew his whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
45' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Diego Marino easily deals with the threat.
44' The referee blows his whistle as Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) was too aggressive in his challenge.
43' Almeria players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
40' Javier Alberola Rojas shows a yellow card to Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.

39' Luis Suarez (Almeria) was close to scoring after a great solo effort and unleashed a promising shot from the edge of the penalty area. The ball went towards the bottom left corner, but Stole Dimitrievski showed his agility and saved this one.
38' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
37' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul.
35' The game is interrupted now, Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
33' Luis Suarez (Almeria) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Stole Dimitrievski.
32' The referee blows for a cooling break.
30' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria), but it's just over the bar.
30' The ball goes out of play. Almeria are awarded a corner kick.

29' Lazaro (Almeria) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Javier Alberola Rojas with no other option than to blow for a foul.
28' 0 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Diego Marino no chance!
28' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
27' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Sergio Akieme (Almeria) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a penalty kick!
26' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
25' A quickly taken corner by Almeria.

24' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Stole Dimitrievski!
23' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
22' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for an infringement.
20' 0 - 1 Goal! Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Diego Marino into left side of the goal.
20' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is going to take the penalty!
18' Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a penalty! Rayo Vallecano have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
16' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
15' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Javier Alberola Rojas saw the whole situation.
14' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

12' Ambitious effort from Adrian Embarba (Almeria). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
11' Flag up against Luis Suarez (Almeria). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
10' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
9' Srdjan Babic (Almeria) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Javier Alberola Rojas has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Rayo Vallecano will take a free kick.
7' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
6' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
4' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) pounces on a cross into the middle of the box, but plants his header well wide of the right post.
2' Almeria are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.

Rayo Vallecano will kick the game off.
